rationale: Record editor-open performance changes that cross these families' selectors. A scripted editor's first load evaluates once on the live realm instead of also on a probe realm; whole scripts (bundles, preludes, runtime-import payloads and inline template scripts) reuse QuickJS bytecode compiled earlier in the same process through JsEngine::evaluate_script, with evaluate()'s results and errors; animation-frame and timer callbacks run through the UI framework's batching hook (@pulp/react runtime fingerprint revision 3); host-embedded editors return their view before evaluating the document (ScopedDeferredDocumentLoad, ScriptedUiSession::load_deferrable); and trace spans name the runtime-import phases. No importer lowering, DesignIR shape, capture path, renderer selection, asset format, fixture or threshold changes, and no existing test's verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the families' coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
